reuse.why: Collapses the five provider link functions into one linkBankSyncAccount, routes the new Fintegra link and both new rules through it, and shares clearAccountBankLink between the takeover and the existing unlinkAccount.

duplication.why: Removes the five copies of the link flow and the unlink field reset; the remaining duplication is downloadFintegraTransactions, a copy of the Akahu download function.

placement.why: Linking rules live in the shared link function in accounts/app.ts and the provider wrappers only map their fields; the duplicate-link query could arguably sit in accounts/link.ts with findOrCreateBank, and accountSyncSource is typed as a plain string.

scope.why: Every edit serves the refactor, the two linking rules, the takeover flag or the Fintegra provider.

maintainability.why: One definition of linking with explicit parameters for real provider variation (mask, sync file id, sync-event tables) is easy to own; a copied download function and the string-typed sync source are minor blemishes.

bypasses_abstraction.where: All six provider handlers call linkBankSyncAccount and unlinkAccount uses clearAccountBankLink; nothing goes around them.

disguised_duplication.where: The only duplicated block, downloadFintegraTransactions in accounts/sync.ts, is a plain copy of downloadAkahuTransactions.

abstraction_drift.where: After the refactor, linkBankSyncAccount gains only the request-mandated replaceExistingLink flag and its takeover branch; the closed-account and duplicate checks are general rules, not provider special cases, and no call site bypasses it.
